notes.title: Junk Game Award 2018
notes.content:
This game won the 7th out of 9 in the Japanese Kattoma's JUNK Game Award 2018. 204 people voted.
The lower the rank, the more proof that this is not a bad game. 
I'm glad that the game created by the currently unpopular GameGuru have won this position.

https://www.nicovideo.jp/watch/sm35178126
